GAME INFO

RTP 96% MAX 10,000× 20 PAYLINES

BASE GAME

Wins pay from left to right across 20 paylines. Wild substitutes for all regular symbols except Scatter.

FREE SPINS

3 or more Scatter symbols trigger 10 Free Spins. Free Spin wins use a 2× multiplier. There is no expansion or retrigger. Scatter cash pays anywhere in addition to line wins: 3 = 2×, 4 = 5×, 5+ = 10×. The round ends immediately when the cumulative 10,000× cap is reached.

BONUS BUY

Bonus Buy costs 100× the selected bet and enters 10 Free Spins at 2× after confirmation. It can return zero.

PAYTABLE

Symbol 3× 4× 5×

Demo mode uses precomputed weighted game books and demo chips. Stake sessions use the platform wallet and returned currency. Base and Bonus Buy modes are calibrated to a 96% RTP target. Maximum win is 10,000× bet. Multipliers refer to the ordinary total bet. Only the highest qualifying symbol win on each payline pays. RTP is a long-run average, not a promise for a session.
